text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O didn't show up for practice 
and couldn't be reached... Worried, I went 
looking for her—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, could it be you've come to see me too? 
The me reflected on the lake's surface, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Me too, you see... I couldn't forget that 
face I saw as a child, so I come visit 
like this every now and then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! I-I'm sorry... What have I done?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think that losing my brilliance would 
leave you trembling in polar-night 
cold...!
choice_data_list: No, it's not like I'm scared...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's okay... It's okay! No need to 
sugarcoat it! It was my fault for making 
you feel so helpless!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I swear right here, right now. 
I will never leave you all alone again...!

"...I had plenty of things I wanted to 
call her out on, but seeing that she was 
reflecting on it in her own way, I let it 
slide."
